title: Propose bounded Android Party touch navigation
platforms: Android Party gallery proposal; device validation pending
changes: Define a reviewable EUR Party touch unit using observed pad navigation, explicit empty-area behavior, cancellation and input ownership, with native/cache and device acceptance gates.
validation: Compared existing Android touch, worker/JNI lifecycle, semantic button queue and native emitter boundaries against recorded EUR interpreter and native evidence; documentation only.
limitations: Proposal awaits the upstream TODO specific-unit approval; multi-row routes, timing, reliable scene identity, lifecycle cancellation, native cache and Android device behavior remain unverified. No runtime implementation.
